title: SEC filing: SpaceX will reserve up to 5% of its Class A shares for select employees and executives' friends and family; 60%+ of shares have an extended lock-up (Charles Capel/Bloomberg)
summary: Charles Capel / Bloomberg: SEC filing: SpaceX will reserve up to 5% of its Class A shares for select employees and executives' friends and family; 60%+ of shares have an extended lock-up — SpaceX will reserve up to 5% of shares in its upcoming initial public offering for certain employees and friends and family …
